title: Full-application performance baseline and validation
scope: Local UI/backend/Keycloak with configured remote MySQL workflows; baseline and follow-up definition only. No application, backend or database schema fixes were applied.

methodology.auth: User-authorized real credentials used only by isolated test browsers. Real Keycloak token exchange and backend account sync; no synthetic authentication or mocked API responses.
methodology.data: Private audit projects created through the UI, seeded with deterministic local fixtures through the actual API, and deleted at completion. Existing projects were not edited. The standalone transport probe used a separate private project.
methodology.fixtureSetup: The revision guard failed in a preliminary setup. Subsequent fixture seeding used the existing optional-revision legacy API. The separate fresh-revision test and native UI save test still exercise the real guard; this is not reported as a product fix.
methodology.navigation: Time to visible route heading/canvas plus two animation frames; not a guarantee that every background request, image or Monaco resource has completed. Cold documents use fresh browser contexts; warm transitions use the actual React router through pushState/popstate.
methodology.cpu: CDP TaskDuration delta measures main-thread busy time. SystemInfo CPU-time deltas sum surviving Chromium processes; 100% means one logical CPU core, not the whole laptop. Short-lived process CPU can be missed. Background applications were not disabled.
methodology.memory: JS heap only. Navigation samples explicitly collect garbage; ordinary interval heaps do not and should not be compared as leak measurements. Browser/GPU/native memory was not measured.
methodology.simulation: 36 components/75 wires, built-in deterministic firmware, compiled AVR mode observed in the actual UI. Two unprofiled 30-second windows per mode; an additional production 10-second CPU-profile window is separate diagnostic evidence.
methodology.backend: 10 sequential authenticated requests per endpoint after workflows. Medians/maxima are reported; no meaningful p95 claim is made from this small sample. No Server-Timing breakdown was exposed. Actuator readings include other server activity.
methodology.database: Read-only schema/index/digest inspection of the BL-configured MySQL database. Digests are cumulative and cannot attribute historical maximum query time to this audit.
methodology.productionCorrection: An initial route-fulfillment delivery attempt triggered Chromium local-network access checks and was excluded. Final production uses real HTTP on free IPv4 loopback port 3000 while the existing IPv6 Vite server remains running. No security feature was disabled.
exclusions: Production deployment/CORS/CSP acceptance on external hosts
Other hardware, higher DPR or physical-display scanout
Long-duration leak proof beyond the measured 60-second simulation and five navigation cycles
